schoolPressures.detail: Pre-university colleges are in Sirsi and Siddapur; infrequent buses cross roads that wash out in monsoon.

schoolPressures.label: Seasonal disease
schoolPressures.detail: Kyasanur Forest Disease outbreak months and precaution drives can disrupt attendance.

schoolPressures.label: Thin schools

schoolPressures.label: Harvest chores
schoolPressures.detail: She helps sort and dry areca nuts after school during the harvest weeks.

pressures: The pre-university colleges are in Sirsi and Siddapur, so infrequent buses and washed-out monsoon roads decide whether his daughter can keep going after Class 10.
Kyasanur Forest Disease months and precaution drives can keep his daughter home, and each missed spell makes it harder to catch up.
In a small hamlet the government school is more likely to be understaffed or single-teacher, so what she learns by Class 10 depends on who is posted.
During harvest weeks she sorts and dries areca nuts after school, which eats study time just when the family is busiest.
factorEffects.sanitation: If his household lacked a proper toilet, his 15-year-old daughter would feel it first; the card gives no sign this is his family's problem.
factorEffects.district: The factor flags the share of English-medium schools in Uttara Kannada. The card shows distance, disease months, thin hamlet schools and harvest chores as the pressures, not language.

changes.effect: The Sirsi area has the lowest share of classrooms in good condition in Karnataka; in heavy monsoons a leaking or unsafe room can stop lessons in its thin village schools.
It also has the lowest share of schools on all-weather roads; for his daughter, 15, a washed-out road on hilly terrain can mean days without school.
More women teachers could make his daughter more comfortable staying on in high school, where the village schools are already thin.

lag.effect: Very few schools here have computer labs, so his daughter may get little of the digital learning that matters for work in a city like Bengaluru, where his elder son now lives.

schoolPressures.label: Boat work
schoolPressures.detail: A boat owner's steady wages can pull a Class 10 boy into paid harbour work.

schoolPressures.label: Drying-yard work
schoolPressures.detail: Peak-season fish processing draws adolescent girls into paid labour.

schoolPressures.label: Thinner government schools
schoolPressures.detail: Private English-medium schools draw better-off families, leaving poorer ones in under-resourced government schools.

schoolPressures.label: Commute & safety
schoolPressures.detail: A daughter's commute to a distant pre-university college raises safety and cost worries.

pressures: A boat owner's steady wages can pull her Class 10 son into paid harbour work, so a ready job competes with the exam year.
Peak-season fish processing draws adolescent girls into paid work, which could affect her 12-year-old daughter as she grows older.
Better-off families move to private English-medium schools, leaving poorer ones in thinner government schools, so her children get less from the same years.
A distant pre-university college raises cost and safety worries for her daughter, so the commute may end her schooling after Class 10.
factorEffects.sanitation: If her household lacked a proper toilet, her 12-year-old daughter's attendance would suffer first as she nears puberty.
factorEffects.district: The factor flags the share of English-medium schools in Udupi. The card notes that private English-medium schools draw better-off families, leaving poorer ones in thinner government schools, which is how it could touch her children.

changes.effect: Udupi already leads Karnataka on protected wells at schools; keeping safe water at school protects her children from illness that costs school days.
Many of Udupi's teachers are women; for her daughter, 12, that can make the move up to high school feel safer.
Teachers trained in computers can make lessons clearer and more engaging for her son, 16, when boat work pulls at the family.

lag.factor: % Schools with Boundary Wall (No boundary walls)
lag.effect: Some schools here still lack a boundary wall, a safety worry for a family that already weighs the commute and safety on the way to school.
